Class NetMessage

java.lang.Object
QueueNet.NetMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class NetMessage extends Object implements Cloneable
This class implements a message which could be received for example by a NetNode or by a NodeSection.
Author:
Francesco Radaelli
